en.title: Tom Cruise's 'Relentless' Work Ethic Praised by 'Digger' Co-Stars
en.summary: The cast of Alejandro G. Iñárritu's upcoming film 'Digger' is singing the praises of star Tom Cruise, highlighting his intense dedication on set. Actors Riz Ahmed and Sandra Hüller describe Cruise's approach as 'relentless' and him as an incredible scene partner.
en.body:
The buzz surrounding Alejandro G. Iñárritu's forthcoming black comedy, **Digger**, is intensifying, and much of the conversation is centering on its star, **Tom Cruise**. While **Cruise** is no stranger to demanding roles and a famously rigorous work ethic, his co-stars in this ambitious project are speaking out about the profound impact he's had on set.

Oscar winner **Riz Ahmed** and Oscar nominee **Sandra Hüller**, both integral to the **Digger** ensemble, have shared their experiences working with the action icon. Describing **Cruise** as "relentless" and "brilliant" in his approach to the character, they paint a picture of an actor deeply committed to his craft and his collaborators. The film, slated for a 2026 release, is a satirical black comedy co-produced by the United States, United Kingdom, and Mexico, and directed by the acclaimed **Iñárritu**. The cast also includes **John Goodman**, **Michael Stuhlbarg**, and **Jesse Plemons**, promising a powerhouse lineup for this unique project.

## A 'Sweet' Collaboration on Set

The admiration for **Tom Cruise** extends beyond mere professional respect. In candid discussions, cast members have revealed a deep appreciation for his presence as a scene partner. One co-star, speaking about the experience, expressed, "> I've never felt more uplifted by a co-star than I have by Sweet Tom. He's incredible."

This sentiment underscores a collaborative environment where **Cruise** apparently fosters a supportive atmosphere, even amidst the intensity of filmmaking. The description of him as "the greatest scene partner in the world" suggests a willingness to engage, elevate, and push the boundaries of performance alongside his fellow actors. **Hüller**, in particular, has alluded to the "huge task" placed upon her shoulders in the film, hinting at the emotional and thematic weight **Cruise** likely helps to carry and amplify within their shared scenes. The film's premise, described as the "most powerful man in the world" on a mission before a disaster he unleashed, suggests a complex character that **Cruise** is embodying with his signature intensity.

## What This Means for 'Digger' Fans

For the legions of fans eagerly anticipating **Digger**, these insights offer a compelling reason for excitement. Knowing that **Tom Cruise** is not only starring but is also deeply invested in his performance and in supporting his castmates suggests a film that will deliver on multiple levels. The combination of **Iñárritu**'s visionary direction, a sharp satirical script, and a cast performing at their peak, fueled by **Cruise**'s "relentless" energy, positions **Digger** as a must-see event. The film promises a unique blend of dark humor and potent commentary, and the collaborative spirit highlighted by the cast suggests it will be a truly memorable cinematic experience.

## What's Next

**Digger** is scheduled for theatrical release in October 2026. Further details regarding promotional tours and specific character revelations are expected as the release date approaches.

content_raw: Tom Cruise has proven time and again that he is a force to be reckoned with in Hollywood, but his collaboration with Academy Award-winning director Alejandro G. Iñárritu on Digger is a whole new look for the action star — literally. Prosthetics aside, even the A-list cast is impressed by what’s been done on set. While talking with Collider’s Steve Weintraub , Oscar winner Riz Ahmed and Oscar nominee Sandra Hüller call the actor and producer “relentless.”
